verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an integrations section under docs.sprinto.com/integrations/overview with per-tool setup guides for Jira, ClickUp (ticketing), JumpCloud (identity) and FreeAgent (offboarding checks), and states it integrates with your existing cloud stack. That shows a real documented catalog. However, the evidence names no specific cloud provider, code-hosting or MDM connector and never mentions read-only scopes or permissions. Missing for 10: named cloud-provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) integration docs, code-hosting integrations, MDM integrations, documented read-only scopes/permissions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Sprinto integrates with ClickUp ticketing system.
choose ClickUp under Ticketing Systems from the list and click on connect
It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
integrating with your existing cloud stack, continuously monitoring your systems
